scenes.purpose: Enter Glassvale through the Mistgate, meet Monica, Maya, Sam, and leaders; plant first Whisper-Moth clue.
Experience all three Paths in Common Term; establish friction with Jorge/Marissa, rivalry with Victor, warmth from Peter.
Bell-Choosing Ceremony and spooky Deep Gate encounter with Silas and Whisper-Moths.
Clara earns real trust with Jorge (fixing Cold-Iron pump) and Marissa (healing Blighted oak root).
Victor's Shadow shortcut unleashes stone gargoyles; trio + Jorge defend courtyard; Monica reveals World-Glass & Crown Seal.
Stormy Bell-Vault confrontation with Silas and Ink-Hounds; Clara refuses his trap and escapes up the belfry.
Trio combines Pure Magic, Nora's Clock-Beetle coil, and Maya's storm-wind teamwork to break free and descend.
Climax: Clara threads Pure Magic through Jorge's coil and Marissa's vines as Maya and Sam ring all three bells together.
Autumn feast resolution, earned friendships, Monica's second-best toast, and warm closing with Peter's silent sand-timer hint.
